Advanced Research Institute for Informatics, Computing, and Networking (AdRIC) - De La Salle University
meta_description: Advanced Research Institute for Informatics, Computing and Networking (AdRIC) is the research unit of the College of Computer Studies (CCS). Established in 1994 to pursue the research ideals of the college, its tasks include setting the directions and priority research activities in the various fields of computing, commissioning and encouraging research and development projects consistent with identified thrusts and priorities, and seeking collaborative ventures with partners in industry, government and academe to serve society through research.
